CREATE VIEW [DW].[FactCardsRelationshipExposure_PBIen_View]
	AS 

WITH FactCardsRelationshipExposure_Latest AS (
SELECT
max(FDL.BusinessDateSK) AS BusinessDateSK
FROM DW.FactCardsRelationshipExposure_PBIen as FDL
)

Select CCD.*
from DW.FactCardsRelationshipExposure_PBIen as CCD
    INNER JOIN FactCardsRelationshipExposure_Latest as FDL
        ON FDL.BusinessDateSK = CCD.BusinessDateSK
